confidence_notes: Food estimates use [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Foz-do-Igua%C3%A7u-Brazil) and June 2026 [Livingcost](https://livingcost.org/cost/brazil/foz-do-iguacu) data, but crowdsourced prices and July-specific conditions limit precision. Cocktail pricing uses beer-relative markups and a [local bar guide](https://www.grupodicas.com/melhores-pubs-e-bares-em-foz-do-iguacu/); wine uses a beer-relative markup. Accommodation is a holistic estimate and may vary with location and holiday demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Local food data and general knowledge of southern Brazilian inland tourism hubs inform the estimates, with an allowance for demand around the waterfalls and July school holidays.
